meta.title: Islamic Learning Library — Aqeedah, Seerah, Fiqh & Qur'an Study
meta.description: Inside the app's learning library: cited lessons on aqeedah, the prophets, the seerah, the Hereafter, Qur'an study, and practical fiqh guides with checklists.

title: Learn your deen, deeply
intro: {appName} is more than a tracker. It's a structured path reviewed for authenticity — creed, history, the Qur'an, and fiqh with progress, quizzes, and citations on every lesson.

creed.title: Creed, history & the Hereafter
creed.description: Ground your imaan in what you believe, where you come from, and where you're going.

quran.title: Read, understand, and memorize
quran.description: A guided path from the Arabic letters to tajweed, memorization, and reflection.

worshipGuides.title: Practical worship guides
worshipGuides.description: Clear, evidence-based guides with checklists, calculators, and trackers for everyday worship.

lifeGuides.title: Companions, dua & life guides
lifeGuides.description: Practical topics for every season — from the sahaba and early history to Laylat al-Qadr, Eid, and everyday finance.

trust.title: Knowledge you can rely on
trust.description: The library is designed to teach faithfully — cited, tracked, and always available.

aqeedah.title: Aqeedah
aqeedah.description: The six articles of faith, tawheed, and the names and attributes of Allah.

prophets.title: The Prophets
prophets.description: From Adam to Muhammad ﷺ, with the lessons carried by each story.

seerah.title: Seerah & battles
seerah.description: The life of the Prophet ﷺ and the major campaigns, with leadership lessons.

jannah.title: Jannah
jannah.description: The reality of Paradise, its ranks, and the deeds that open its gates.

jahannam.title: Jahannam
jahannam.description: A balanced warning — its names, major sins, and the ever-open door of repentance.

lastDay.title: The Last Day
lastDay.description: The signs, the reckoning, the Scale, and the Bridge — with an interactive quiz.

readArabic.title: Read the Arabic
readArabic.description: Letters and their forms, pronunciation drills, and a learn-to-read path.

tajweed.title: Tajweed
tajweed.description: Noon and meem sakinah, madd, qalqalah, ghunnah, and the rules of stopping.

memorize.title: Memorize
memorize.description: Hifz plans, revision, and khatm tracking to keep you moving.

understand.title: Understand & reflect
understand.description: Themes, prophet stories, vocabulary by root, and daily tadabbur prompts.

salahGuide.title: Salah guide
salahGuide.description: From why we pray to khushu' and making up missed prayers, step by step.

taharah.title: Taharah
taharah.description: Wudu, ghusl, and tayammum with a daily purification checklist.

zakat.title: Zakat
zakat.description: Nisab thresholds, an interactive calculator, and Qur'an and hadith evidence.

hajj.title: Hajj & Umrah
hajj.description: An interactive, offline checklist for every rite with location context.

concessions.title: Travel, illness & hayd
concessions.description: Qasr and jam', worship when ill, and menstruation fiqh — worship at your capacity.

ramadan.title: Ramadan, Tahajjud & journal
ramadan.description: A fasting tracker with suhoor/iftar times, a night-prayer log, and a khushu' prayer journal.

friday.title: Friday & Jumu'ah
friday.description: Ghusl, Surah Al-Kahf, salawat and the hour of dua, with a Friday checklist.

fasts.title: White Days & voluntary fasts
fasts.description: The 13th to 15th of each Hijri month, Mondays and Thursdays, Arafah, Ashura and more, with prohibited days flagged.

janazah.title: Janazah
janazah.description: The funeral prayer, washing and burial, with authentic duas for the deceased.

sahaba.title: The Sahaba
sahaba.description: Virtues, lessons, and citations from the noble companions of the Prophet ﷺ.

history.title: Early Islamic history
history.description: From the Khulafa Rashidun through the Umayyad period — context for today's ummah.

learnDua.title: Learn dua
learnDua.description: When and how to supplicate — with Arabic, transliteration, and evidence for each occasion.

newMuslim.title: New Muslim guide
newMuslim.description: A gentle on-ramp for converts — Salah, wudu, adhkar, and building a daily rhythm.

laylatAlQadr.title: Laylat al-Qadr
laylatAlQadr.description: The Night of Decree — its virtue, signs, and how to seek it in the last ten nights.

eid.title: Eid guide
eid.description: Fitr and Adha — takbir, prayer, Sunnah acts, and the spirit of celebration.

ruqyah.title: Ruqyah
ruqyah.description: Qur'anic and prophetic healing supplications — with conditions and etiquette.

finance.title: Islamic finance
finance.description: Riba, halal income, zakat principles, and everyday money matters — educational, not fatwa.

dailyHadith.title: Daily hadith
dailyHadith.description: A hadith from Imam al-Nawawi's Forty each morning, with its explanation.

flashCards.title: Flash cards
flashCards.description: Review the Qur'an, hadith, the Names of Allah and every guide, one card at a time.

referenced.title: Referenced to source
referenced.description: Every claim is tied to the Qur'an and graded hadith, with collection and number.

progress.title: Track your progress
progress.description: Per-topic completion means you always know exactly where you left off.

quizzes.title: Quizzes & timelines
quizzes.description: Interactive quizzes and visual timelines make what you learn actually stick.

offline.title: Fully offline
offline.description: The entire library works without a connection — read anywhere, anytime.
